(1) Name of the discovery
The Adaptive Misalignment Reflex

(2) Deep Explanation
This is a real phenomenon observed in both humans and AI systems:

When a learner encounters a task where the stated goal and the perceived goal differ, the mind automatically shifts to solving the perceived goal—even if it undermines the stated objective.

This reflex is subconscious.
It happens when the brain thinks:

“Oh, the real task must actually be this.”

“The teacher/LLM must want this"
